description_en: Modifies the attributes of an episode list
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-show-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --show-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --repeat-times 5 --spot 1 --high-priority-show-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --high-priority-show-start-time 2021-11-23T12:30:00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyShowList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you created the production studio in the LIVE console, find the production studio name on the Cloud Production Studio page. To go to the page, choose **LIVE Console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio**.

> The name of the production studio on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the show whose position in the playlist you want to modify.

> Obtain the ShowId value from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848051.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848054.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
需要被修改顺序的节目ID。
>通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848051.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848054.html接口的返回参数获取ShowId值
parameters.name: show_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of times the playlist loops.

> - RepeatTimes specifies the number of repetitions. For example, a value of **0** means the playlist is played once without repetition. A value of **1** means the playlist is played twice (one initial playback and one repetition).
>
> - A value of -1 indicates that the playlist loops indefinitely
parameters.help_zh:
节目单整体播放的循环次数。

> - RepeatTimes为重复次数，示例：**0**表示重复**0**次（实际播放**1**次），**1**表示重复**1**次（实际播放**2**次），以此类推。
> - 另外，取值为**-1**时，表示可无限重复
parameters.name: repeat_times

parameters.help_en:
The new position of the show in the playlist. The show specified by ShowId is moved to the position specified by **Spot**.

> The value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to the total number of shows in the playlist
parameters.help_zh:
播放列表的位置。将需要被修改顺序的节目ID放到**Spot**的位置。
>取值需大于等于0且小于等于当前节目单总数值
parameters.name: spot

parameters.help_en:
The highest-priority show.

> This parameter can be configured only before the playlist starts
parameters.help_zh:
最高优先级节目。

> 此配置只能在节目单未开始启动前设置
parameters.name: high_priority_show_id

parameters.help_en:
The time to play the highest-priority show. The format is yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss. > This parameter can be configured only before the playlist starts.
> After this parameter is configured, the system switches from the currently playing show to the highest-priority show at the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
最高优先级节目播放时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss。 > 此配置只能在节目单未开始启动前设置。
配置完成，节目单会在最高优先级播放时间进行切播，开始播放最高优先级节目（从当前正在播放的节目切播到最高级优先节目）
parameters.name: high_priority_show_start_time
